Name: Cuter Fatter Pinker Strawberry Cows
Author: SaltyCatpuccino
Description:
This mod is a pink/strawberry recoloring of Identitypollution's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/348]Cuter Fatter Cows[/url]. Identitypollution has given me permission to post this mod which I am deeply grateful for! I highly recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/34213720]checking out their mods[/url] as they are completely adorable and are what inspired me to make this in the first place!

[b]To Install:
[/b]1. Download this mod and unzip in your mods folder
2. Run the game using SMAPI

[b]Please note[/b]
If you are using '[font=Courier New]Cuter Fatter Animals[/font]' please enter the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] there and set '[font=Courier New]replace W-Cow[/font]' to '[font=Courier New]false[/font]'
[b]
[/b][b]Mods used in pictures[/b]

The buildings I am using are from Flower Valley which is no longer hosted on Nexus - I got my copy from [url=https://kayainsdv.postype.com/post/10220280]here[/url] (The authors personal site)
